design: purposively selected descriptive case verification and isolated software replay
selection_basis: existing candidate notes and publicly collected locators; selected before this replay
checks: Re-observe the five selected platform locator records using four bounded public searches.
Compare public displayed labels and page positions with an independently available external scan; do not infer identical copies.
Inspect the selected source pages and distinguish transcription, page role, and taxonomic interpretation.
Run the unchanged prototype on page-preserving excerpts of the public PDFs in a new disposable local store.
Check literal target strings, repeated-occurrence grouping, printed-label retention, and context-extension constraints.
Retain failures and ambiguous observations; do not present counts as collection-wide accuracy, recall, efficiency, or user benefit.
offline_conditions: No language-model, vector-provider or new recognition service; only the existing PDF text layer and rule extraction.
claim_for_documentary_context_check: The final statement in the selected volume describes the flowers of Psilopeganum sinense as white.
claim_scope: What the selected historical document says after its correction, not a claim about the species in nature.
inspection_identity: documentary source inspection; no human/external expert participation has been recorded
